name: oxfordra-website
description: Build and verification tooling for oxfordra.net. `npm run build` assembles the dist/ publish directory (the same command netlify.toml runs); `npm run verify` is the full pre-merge gate that .github/workflows/ci.yml executes. Also pins netlify-cli to a tested version so deploys resolve a local install instead of npx's evictable cache.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-listings.mjs --check && node scripts/build-portfolio.mjs --check && node scripts/build-kb.mjs && node scripts/build-dist.mjs
scripts.test:site: node --test tests/site/recaptcha-sitekey.test.mjs tests/site/csp-smoke.test.mjs tests/site/serve-dist-args.test.mjs tests/site/seo.test.mjs tests/site/seo-entity.test.mjs tests/site/analytics.test.mjs tests/site/netlify-forms.test.mjs tests/site/form-validator.test.mjs tests/site/site-integrity.test.mjs tests/site/mobile-nav.test.mjs tests/site/client-robustness.test.mjs tests/site/broker-score-card.test.mjs tests/site/upload-budget.test.mjs tests/site/listings-ui.test.mjs tests/site/map-ui.test.mjs tests/site/portfolio-map-ui.test.mjs tests/site/csp-hashes.test.mjs tests/site/csp-all-pages.test.mjs tests/site/a11y-logo.test.mjs tests/site/site-plumbing.test.mjs tests/site/cookie-banner.test.mjs tests/site/announcement-bar-contrast.test.mjs tests/site/contact-copy.test.mjs tests/site/contact-form-hint.test.mjs tests/site/consent-mode.test.mjs tests/site/asset-versioning.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:leak-gate && npm run verify:jsonld && npm run test:unit && npm run test:site && npm run test:shim && npm run test:functions
